fields.System.Title: Show which filters are active on the report list header
fields.System.Description:
Filters are applied from a side panel that closes after use, so the list gives no sign that it is filtered. Users read a partial list as the full one and report missing records that were only hidden.

Scope: the report list header.
Out of scope: the filter panel itself and saved-filter management.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
• Every active filter appears in the header as a removable chip.
  • Removing a chip re-runs the query without a page reload.
  • With no filters active the header shows no chip row at all, not an empty one.
  • The chips survive a browser refresh.
